The '''Deadalis sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]] and the [[Coth Fuuras space station]].
